_comment: Default lanes for astrafabulopus. Layers merge per lane, lowest first: this file, then ~/.claude/astrafabulopus/lanes.json (written by /astrafabulopus:setup or `af-council promote`), then the project's .claude/orchestra/lanes.json. So a project can change one lane's effort without restating the rest. `--config PATH` on any af-* command uses that file alone. Codex slugs verified 2026-09-27 on a ChatGPT-account login with Codex CLI 0.157.1: gpt-6-luna, gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-astra run; Codex 0.154 rejected the GPT-6 Luna/Sol slugs ('not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account'), so run `codex update` before falling back to the 5.6 slugs. Model talents and prices live in models.json (the Potato Council).

frontier._note: Occasional. After Sol and Opus both failed a task, or a deliberate one-off. Astra's output is 5x GPT-6 Sol's and 100x GPT-6 Luna's API-equivalent price; the ChatGPT subscription absorbs it, but every Astra call is one the architect chose.

consult._note: Read-only cross-vendor advisor used by af-consult and the astra-advisor agent. A trivial consult took 8 seconds.

review._note: Used by af-review (codex exec review). Pass --model gpt-6-astra for a release review.

local._note: Experimental and off. provider is lmstudio or ollama (base_url is only used for the reachability preflight). Verified 2026-09-26: Codex's built-in LM Studio provider completed a trivial write task with qwen3.6-27b-mlx in 195 s where GPT Luna took 14 s. A GGUF Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B failed under Codex because its chat template demands the system message first. Local buys cost, not speed.

reviewer._note: The fable-advisor agent pins this in its frontmatter; listed for reference.

claude_builder._note: The opus-implementer agent pins this in its frontmatter; listed for reference.

verify._note: Optional: the project's full verification command, used by af-verify when no command is given, e.g. "swift test -c release" or "npm test".
